scripts.build: npm run build -w @felix-ayush/openhearth-core && npm run build -w @felix-ayush/openhearth && npm run build -w @openhearth/site
scripts.build:cli: npm run build -w @felix-ayush/openhearth-core && npm run build -w @felix-ayush/openhearth
scripts.dev:cli: npm run build:cli && npm run start -w @felix-ayush/openhearth --
scripts.publish:packages: npm run build:cli && npm publish -w @felix-ayush/openhearth --access public
scripts.test: npm run test -w @felix-ayush/openhearth-core && npm run test -w @felix-ayush/openhearth
